_about: Heartside's social library on Drive, the second library the library sync writes (Krish, 2026-11-03: "Why don't you duplicate that Python script for Heartside then? We're going to need to do a lot more of this type of stuff moving forward"). Kept apart from studio.json, whose contents are bound into the media standard's hash. The sync finds the folder by drive_id through the engine (Krish, 2026-11-09: "ideally ID so if folders move it doesnt matter"; api/library/_heartsideFolder.ts), so a rename or a move needs nothing here; root is the fallback path on the home computers' H: drive, used only when the engine cannot say; MINDMAKE_HEARTSIDE_LIBRARY_ROOT overrides both on one machine. drive_id is the same folder by ID (verified 2026-11-03 as Heartside/05_Social-Library; Krish renamed it Heartside/03b_Social-Schedule on 2026-11-09, same ID: "Folder 3A is where we're iterating on creatives, and folder 3B is where they're ready for production."). docs/DRIVE.md lists it.
